description: Native Sim sidebar, workflows, DAGs and agent sessions with an isolated extension-owned runtime.
command.signInAgent: Sign In to Agent for This Instance
command.openAgentConfiguration: Open Agent Configuration for This Instance
configuration.codexSandbox: Default and maximum Codex sandbox permission for this Sim instance. Choose workspace-write to offer project writes. Only user/remote machine settings are used; workspace overrides are ignored. Stop and start the Sim runtime after changing this setting.
configuration.allowUnrestricted: Allow the explicit Unrestricted choice in Sim sessions. This disables execution sandboxing and approvals for a session that selects it, allowing access outside the project with the service account's permissions. It never becomes the default. Only user/remote machine settings are used; workspace overrides are ignored. Stop and start the Sim runtime after changing this setting.
configuration.codexExecutable: Codex executable in the workspace Extension Host. Only user/remote machine settings are used; workspace overrides are ignored. Stop and start the Sim runtime after changing this setting. Credentials and sessions always stay in this Sim instance's private profile.
configuration.claudeExecutable: Claude Code executable in the workspace Extension Host. Only user/remote machine settings are used; workspace overrides are ignored. Stop and start the Sim runtime after changing this setting. Credentials and sessions always stay in this Sim instance's private profile.
